Steamatic is Australia’s longest established and largest restoration Company with over 35 locations throughout Australia and growing each year. We have available work Nationwide in Metropolitan and Regional areas.

We are now looking to recruit an experienced and qualified IT Support Technician to join our dedicated service team working in various locations throughout Australia.

The Role
We are looking for technically skilled candidate with good problem-solving ability for the position of IT Support Technician. The duties include being a reference point for all IT related queries at the user level, responding to user needs in a timely manner and ensuring the optimal running of all systems, among other technical duties.

The role includes but is not limited to the following duties:
Installing and configuring hardware and software components to ensure usability
Diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving connectivity, hardware, and software issues
Performing tests and evaluations of new software and hardware
Scheduling and conducting quality audit inspections, and analysing and reviewing systems, data and documentation
Identifying variations and potential high-risk areas in securing adherence to standards and procedures
Recommending corrective action plans and improvements in the resolution of non- compliance with standards detected through monitoring and auditing of processes and procedures
Communicating, educating, and liaising with users and management to ensure awareness and adherence to standards, procedures and quality control issues and activities
Assisting in troubleshooting, diagnosing, testing and resolving system problems and issues
Developing, conducting, and offering technical guidance and training in application software and operational procedures
Analysing, evaluating, and diagnosing technical problems and issues such as installation, maintenance, repair, upgrade and configuration and troubleshooting of desktops, software, hardware, printers, Internet, email, databases, operating systems and security systems
Testing, identifying and diagnosing functionality errors and faults in systems, and programming code within established testing protocols, guidelines and quality standards to ensure systems perform to specification
Performing organisational systems architecture reviews and assessments, and recommending current and future hardware and software strategies and directions
Creating and reviewing technical documentation such as procedural, instructional and operational guides and manuals, technical reports and specifications and maintenance inventory systems
Using project management methodologies, principles, and techniques to develop project plans and to cost, resource and manage projects
Test plans, which ensure acceptable quality and integrity of the system
Creating user and training documentation, and conducting formal training classes
Establishing good relationships with all departments and colleagues
Working with users to formulate and document business requirement
Investigating, and analysing business processes, procedures and work practices

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Previous work experience in the same field
3+ years of experience in computer networks and systems maintenance
Proficiency in computer systems, software installation, database programming, and cybersecurity basics
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Good interpersonal skills
Strong problem-solving, and time management skills
Attention to detail
Self-motivated and eager to learn and grow within the organisation

If you have the skills required for this role and you feel this is the job for you, then apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Database Administrator to join our team and take ownership of the design, implementation, and ongoing management of our database systems. The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring the integrity, security, and performance of organisational data assets. This role suits a proactive and technically proficient professional with a strong background in database management and a commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality data infrastructure. Experience working within a collaborative IT environment and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders will be highly regarded.
## Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain database architecture, data structures, tables, and naming conventions to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and completeness of all data master files
- Establish, monitor, and maintain backup and recovery procedures, ensuring business continuity and minimal disruption in the event of a system failure
- Implement and enforce database security protocols, integrity controls, and access management policies to safeguard sensitive organisational data
- Administer and maintain comprehensive database documentation, including guidelines, policies, and operational procedures, ensuring these remain current and fit for purpose
- Plan and perform database upgrades, patches, and migrations, including thorough testing, debugging, and issue resolution in accordance with approved quality assurance processes
- Monitor database performance on an ongoing basis, identifying bottlenecks and implementing tuning, indexing, and optimisation strategies to maximise efficiency
- Collaborate with developers, systems analysts, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into effective and scalable database solutions
- Analyse existing database systems and workflows, recommending and implementing improvements to enhance reliability, performance, and maintainability
- Provide technical support and troubleshooting assistance for database-related incidents, working to resolve issues promptly and minimise operational impact
- Ensure database environments comply with relevant data governance frameworks, privacy legislation, and organisational standards, including alignment with Australian Privacy Principles where applicable
- Assist in capacity planning activities by assessing current usage trends and forecasting future storage and performance requirements
- Support the development and maintenance of data integration processes, including ETL pipelines and data warehouse environments, in collaboration with cross-functional teams
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience
- Demonstrated experience in a Database Administrator or similar role, with hands-on responsibility for managing enterprise-level database environments
- Proficiency in one or more leading relational database management systems, such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, or PostgreSQL
- Strong working knowledge of SQL, including query writing, stored procedures, functions, and performance tuning
- Experience designing and implementing backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies in production environments
- Solid understanding of database security principles, including user access controls, encryption, and audit logging
- Ability to diagnose and resolve complex database performance issues through monitoring tools, execution plans, and indexing strategies
- Familiarity with data modelling techniques and the ability to translate business requirements into well-structured database designs
- Sound understanding of IT service management practices and experience working within structured change management processes
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a methodical approach to troubleshooting
- Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to liaise confidently with both technical teams and business stakeholders
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant vendor certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate, Oracle Database Administrator Certified Professional, or equivalent
- Experience with cloud-based database platforms, including Azure SQL, Amazon RDS, or Google Cloud SQL
- Exposure to NoSQL database technologies such as MongoDB, Cassandra, or Redis
- Experience in data warehousing environments and familiarity with ETL tools and processes
- Knowledge of scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash for automation of routine database tasks
- Familiarity with DevOps practices and experience working within Agile or ITIL-aligned environments
- Prior experience in a regulated industry such as finance, healthcare, or government, with an understanding of associated compliance obligations
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a supportive and collaborative team culture that values continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and professional development
- Access ongoing training opportunities, certification support, and clear pathways for career progression within a growing technology function
- Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid work options, to support a healthy work-life balance
- Work on meaningful, complex data challenges that have a genuine impact across the organisation
- Receive a competitive remuneration package with additional benefits including superannuation, annual leave loading, and access to an employee wellbeing programme
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Type: Full-time

Location: Cairns City QLD 4870

About the Business:
Goyal Companies Pty Ltd operates a busy Subway franchise located in the heart of Cairns, Queensland. As part of the globally recognised Subway brand, the store delivers fresh, made-to-order submarine sandwiches, salads, and wraps to a diverse customer base of locals, shoppers, and tourists. The business is committed to excellence in food quality, customer service, and operational standards while fostering a supportive, team-oriented workplace culture that values accountability, continuous improvement, and work-life balance for its leadership team.
About the Position:
This full-time Retail Manager (General) role has been created to professionalise the day-to-day operations of the Subway store, reducing the current heavy reliance on the business owner. Reporting directly to the owner/franchisee, the Retail Manager will take full responsibility for leading operations, staff management, compliance, inventory, and customer service excellence. This key leadership position will enable the business to operate independently and sustainably, supporting long-term growth and allowing the owner to focus on strategic development.
Key Responsibilities:
Organise, direct and control the daily operations of the restaurant to ensure efficient and profitable performance in line with Subway franchise standards.
Manage inventory levels, purchasing, stock control, and wastage to maintain optimal product availability and quality.
Lead staff recruitment, training, rostering, supervision, and performance management to build a capable and motivated team.
Uphold exceptional customer service standards, resolve complaints promptly, and monitor feedback to drive continuous improvement.
Ensure full compliance with food safety, workplace health and safety, franchise policies, and all regulatory requirements.
Monitor sales, labour costs, and operational expenses, implementing strategies to improve profitability and efficiency.
Oversee marketing activities, promotional campaigns, and third-party delivery platforms to support business growth.
Manage operational issues, staff shortages, and day-to-day decision-making to ensure business continuity without constant owner involvement.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Minimum Diploma in Business Management, Retail Management or Hospitality Management (particularly for fast food or quick service restaurants).
Minimum 1 year in retail food management, with strong leadership and people management skills.
Demonstrated experience managing retail, fast-food, hospitality or franchise operations, including inventory control, workforce management, food safety, WHS, and compliance.
Proven ability to analyse business performance, implement operational improvements, and deliver excellent customer service.
Strong communication, organisational, problem-solving and leadership skills with the ability to foster a positive team culture.

result.description:
We are seeking an experienced and proactive Accommodation & Hospitality Manager to oversee the daily operations of our guest house accommodation business, specialising in privately managed short-stay holiday properties throughout Yamba, NSW.

This is a hands-on management role with a significant focus on housekeeping operations, property presentation and ensuring every guest enjoys an exceptional accommodation experience.

Key Responsibilities
Oversee the day-to-day operations of multiple guest house and private short-stay accommodation properties.
Plan, coordinate and supervise housekeeping activities to ensure all accommodation is cleaned, presented and maintained to a consistently high standard.
Develop cleaning schedules, inspection procedures and quality assurance processes to maintain guest satisfaction.
Recruit, train, supervise and support housekeeping and accommodation staff.
Prepare staff rosters and allocate duties to ensure operational efficiency.
Monitor accommodation occupancy, coordinate guest arrivals and departures, and ensure properties are ready for check-in.
Respond professionally to guest enquiries, requests, complaints and feedback, resolving issues promptly.
Monitor operational performance and implement improvements to service quality and efficiency.
Manage inventory levels for linen, amenities, cleaning products and other accommodation supplies.
Coordinate maintenance requirements with contractors to ensure all properties remain safe, functional and well presented.
Assist in preparing and monitoring operational budgets while managing expenditure and controlling operating costs.
Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety requirements, company procedures and accommodation standards.
Maintain accurate operational records, reports and housekeeping documentation.
Work closely with business owners to improve guest services, occupancy outcomes and overall business performance.

About You
Previous experience managing accommodation, guest houses, serviced apartments, hotels or short-stay holiday properties.
Demonstrated leadership experience supervising housekeeping or accommodation teams.
Strong organisational, communication and customer service skills.
Excellent attention to detail with a commitment to maintaining exceptional cleanliness and presentation standards.
Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced hospitality environment.
Relevant hospitality, accommodation management or business qualifications are highly regarded.

What We Offer
Full-time permanent position based in Yamba, NSW.
Salary of $70,000–$85,000 per annum plus superannuation, depending on qualifications and experience.
Supportive working environment with opportunities for professional development.
We are an eligible regional employer and welcome applications from candidates seeking employer sponsorship. Suitably qualified applicants interested in the Subclass 494 Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional (Provisional) visa pathway are strongly encouraged to apply, as sponsorship may be available for the right candidate.

If you have a passion for accommodation management, exceptional housekeeping standards and delivering outstanding guest experiences, we welcome your application.

Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

Job Title: Retail Store Manager
Employment Type: full-time, permanent
Store Address: 871 Ruthven St, Kearneys Spring Qld 4350
Salary: $65,000 to $80,000 + Superannuation per annum.
ABOUT THE ROLE
Our client PINKU PTY LTD ATF PINKU TRUST, TRADING AS PIZZA HUT TOOWOOMBA is looking for an experienced and hands-on Retail Store Manager to lead the day-to-day operations of our busy dine-in, takeaway and delivery store located at 871 Ruthven St, Kearneys Spring QLD 4350.
RESPONSIBILITY: 
Responsible for the overall management of store operations, staff, stock, customer service and financial performance, ensuring the store consistently delivers on Pizza Hut's quality, safety and service standards.
KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
•	Plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate the day-to-day operations of the store, including dine-in, takeaway and delivery service channels.
•	Formulate and implement store operating policies and procedures consistent with brand standards, food safety regulations and company objectives.
•	Manage and monitor store budgets, sales targets, food and labour costs, wastage and cash-handling procedures to ensure profitability.
•	Recruit, induct, roster, train, supervise and appraise the performance of kitchen hands, pizza makers, delivery drivers and customer service staff.
•	Oversee stock control, including ordering, receipt, storage and rotation of food ingredients and consumables, and liaise with suppliers to ensure timely delivery.
•	Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety, food safety (HACCP) and hygiene standards across all areas of the store.
•	Monitor and maintain consistent product quality, portion control and presentation of pizzas and menu items in line with Pizza Hut recipes and standards.
•	Resolve customer complaints and enquiries promptly and professionally to maintain high levels of customer satisfaction and repeat business.
•	Plan and implement local store marketing initiatives, promotions and community engagement activities to drive sales and brand awareness.
•	Monitor competitor activity, local market trends and customer feedback to identify opportunities for improving store performance.
•	Prepare and analyse sales, labour and financial reports for operational improvement.
•	Ensure the store, equipment, fixtures and delivery vehicles are well maintained, and coordinate repairs and maintenance as required.
•	Ensure compliance with relevant employment legislation, fair work standards and company policies in the management of staff.
•	Manage rostering and staffing levels to meet peak trading periods, special events and seasonal demand fluctuations.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS 

Minimum relevant AQF Diploma or Higher 
Relevant 1 Year work experience 

Application Deadline: 02 August 2026. 

Interested applicants who meet the above criteria are invited to submit a resume and cover letter. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the interview.

We are seeking a Demi Chef/Cook to join our team in Darwin NT.

Our ideal candidate will be:
A natural leader with a track record of supervising a high performing team in a fast-paced kitchen.
Someone who lives and breathes customer service and enjoys communicating with a variety of people. 
An organised, computer literate, admin capable, and pro-active person, who can think on their feet, problem solve during high pressure situations, and delegate tasks efficiently to improve operations. 
Confident, professionally presented, proud to represent our company, enjoys coaching and performance managing a diverse team, and has excellent negotiating skills. 
A person with hands-on experience in a similar role, safely operating kitchen equipment, Inducting and training staff to safely use equipment, knowledge of WH&S best practices, and strong knowledge of food hygiene best practices. 
A people lover who will enjoy working in a diverse team and helping shape their department, leading Elements’ bistro to greater success. 
Reporting to the Head Chef, responsible for all aspects of this busy kitchen, you will help create menus, plan and execute food services for large events, stock control consistently, ensure wastage is kept to an absolute minimum at all times, maintain strict adherence to all health and safety requirements and oversee the smooth running of service, delivering quality meals in a timely and organized manner. 

This role requires:
Previous Cook/Chef experience in a hands-on leadership role
Knowledge of food style and presentation.
Creative approach to food and a passion for your trade.
The ability to be consistent and produce high-quality food.
Experience with catering for large functions and events. 
Flexibility in working a 7-day roster, early starts and evenings. 
Out-of-the-box thinker who likes to challenge the norm.
Registered Food Safety Certificates and other relevant qualifications.
Smile in the face of adversity and set an example for the rest of the team.
Be able to interact with guests and deliver great customer service.
Experience with creating efficient menu’s, controlling waste, and a successful track record achieving excellent COGS percentages will be highly regarded.

If you are up for a challenge and are looking for a great place to work then we want to hear from you!

Benefits:
Potential full-time role with a competitive salary package.
Exceptional opportunity to showcase your skills and gain unrivalled experience and credentials within the hospitality and resort sector. 
Discounted Accommodation (subject to availability).
